params.body:
The server side of three parts of the Studio's writing view: versions with Restore, the plan of a bigger step, and what the desk list shows.

## Versions of a piece

Every save of the text, every accepted suggestion, and every source added or removed by hand is a step in a new `article_versions` table: the time, what happened in the writer's words ("Edited paragraph 2", "Suggestion on a new slide accepted"), what changed in the sources, who, and a snapshot of the title, standfirst, body and sources with the sentence each stands under. A setting (stage, tier, byline) is not a step.

- `GET /articles/:id/versions`, newest first.
- `POST /articles/:id/versions/:vid/restore` puts back the text and the sources and is itself a step, so a restore can be undone the same way. Author or admin only.
- A piece from before versions gets its first step ("Before versions were kept", the piece as it stood) the moment its first change comes in.

## The plan of a bigger step

The writing chat asks the Claude CLI for its event stream (`stream-json` with partial messages; `spawnClaudeStream({events: true})`). The answer still streams as text; each look into the Observatory becomes a step sent to the Studio (running, then done), labelled in the writer's words from the tool's own arguments: "Searching the signals for "student poverty", last 90 days", "Comparing Students and Young Adults on finance". Only the Observatory's tools count as steps, not the CLI's own housekeeping. What it looked at is kept with the answer. The token estimate for these calls counts the text, not the JSON around it.

## Smaller

- The desk list carries each piece's `format`, `deck_brand` and its first 160 characters, so the desk can say what a piece is and how an untitled one begins.
- A dash between numbers reads as a range ("18 to 25") instead of becoming a comma.

## Safe to merge alone

Additive: a new table, new routes, two new list columns. The Studio now on the box does not call the new routes; its chat reads the same `delta`, `suggestions`, `line` and `choices` events as before and ignores the new `step` events.

## Tests

`node --test test/*.test.mjs`: 1084 of 1090 on a fresh worktree from main; the six that fail are `report-render`, which needs `pdftoppm` on the machine that ran them, and fail the same on main there. New: `test/article-versions.test.mjs` (describing a change, saves and accepts as steps, restore of text and sources) and `test/cli-events.test.mjs` (step labels, reading text and steps across chunk borders). Tried end to end against a local server with the real CLI: a comparison and a search shown as steps while running, then the answer.
params.title: Versions of a piece with Restore; the chat's lookups as a plan; the desk list's format
